_readme: Curated milestone captions for timelapse videos. KRISHNA CAN EDIT THIS FILE FREELY. Each entry: year + one-line caption (the renderer prefixes the year, so don't repeat it). When the video passes a milestone year, the year counter pauses ~2.5s and the caption appears as a lower-third. Aim for 4-8 milestones per minute of final video. This scaffold covers 1700-1785; add entries for any range you export.

milestones.caption: Aurangzeb dies; the Mughal decline begins
Farrukhsiyar takes the throne as kingmakers rise behind it
Nizam-ul-Mulk founds the Hyderabad state in the Deccan
Nadir Shah sacks Delhi; the Peacock Throne leaves India
The Carnatic Wars begin — France and Britain fight through Indian allies
Battle of Plassey — the East India Company takes Bengal
Third Battle of Panipat: the Durranis break the Maratha army
Battle of Buxar — Company power reaches up the Ganga
Hyder Ali's Mysore fights the Company to a standstill
Hyder Ali dies; Tipu Sultan takes Mysore
Pitt's India Act puts the Company under Crown oversight
